title: Static Part-Raised Sectional Overhead Door
description: Original independent static fire-station doorway module: two whole inward-open C-section guide tracks bend through a quarter turn into overhead returns, carrying ten separate thick door sections and their visible fixed side rollers in one partly raised pose. Grounded jambs, a front header, track brackets and rear cross tie complete the displayed frame; a real lower passage is left open. No host building or roof is included. This is not a translated single sluice plate or hinged gate. No door motion, rigging, exact roller contact, continuous clearance, mounting compatibility, weather seal, fire resistance, human access, load or safety certification is claimed.
